owner: Dept D Pre-registration Officer (draft for the Director; batch 1b, prescreen #30)
hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. HKEX's after-hours (T+1) HSI futures session prices US/European news with thin local participation; the night-session liquidity providers who absorb that move are paid when local and mainland institutional flow re-prices the index at the day-session open, so a large after-hours move partly reverses in the first ~40 minutes of the next day session (transfer of Miwa 2019 Nikkei night->day reversal and of the 1998-2005 HSI extended-session reversal literature). Sign fixed in advance: FADE the after-hours move (short after a large up-move, long after a large down-move).
rules: Clock: Asia/Hong_Kong (UTC+8, no DST), applied to HistData HKXHKD bars whose ts is bar-open UTC (clock histdata_rule). Trading days d = XHKG sessions (exchange_calendars) with a previous XHKG session p within 5 calendar days; skip d if p was a half-day session. Day close C(p) = close of the last HKX bar with open time in [16:00, 16:29] HKT on p; if none, no trade. After-hours close A(d) = close of the last HKX bar with open time >= 17:15 HKT on p and < 03:00 HKT on the calendar day after p (the vendor file ends the evening near 01:00 HKT); at least 60 bars in that window, else no trade. After-hours move m(d) = ln(A(d)/C(p)). Trigger: |m(d)| > 0.70%. Side = -sign(m(d)) (fade). ENTRY at the open of the 09:20 HKT bar on d (FTMO HK50 open 09:20 HKT = 01:20 UTC); if that bar is missing, no trade. EXIT at the open of the 09:57 HKT bar (fallback: first existing bar in 09:58..09:59; else the close of the last bar in 09:50..09:56, counted and reported). Exit at 09:57 rather than 10:00 keeps the exit order outside +-2 min of 10:00 HKT China NBS releases. One trade per day maximum; no stops, no targets. Trade P&L = w * side * ln(P(exit)/P(entry)) - costs. Gate-2 precondition (outcome-free, decided before the OOS read): the modal first bar of the day session must sit at 09:15 HKT +-2 min in >= 90% of OOS sessions and the 16:30-17:15 HKT session gap must be visible in >= 90% of OOS sessions; otherwise the row is not run and is reported 'data not fit', not 'refuted'.
parameters: AHT move = ln(last AHT close before 03:00 HKT / last day-session close 16:00-16:29 HKT); threshold 0.70% absolute; side fade; entry 09:20 HKT open; exit 09:57 HKT open
instruments: FTMO HK50.cash CFD (tested on HistData HKXHKD 1m bid quotes)
holding: 37 minutes intraday (09:20 -> 09:57 HKT = 01:20 -> 01:57 UTC); about 60-90 triggers/yr (brief estimate, not measured)
vol_scaler: weight w = (0.10/sqrt(252)) / sigma, sigma = EWMA (centre of mass 60 sessions) s.d. of the 09:20->09:57 HKT log return over ALL prior eligible sessions (triggered or not) through p, at least 40 observations; no cap/floor.
cost_model: 1x floor per briefs/00-common.md (index CFDs 0.5-1.5 bp per side): HK50 1.5 bp per side (top of the range; FTMO's HK50 spread is unverified and the sweep brief assumed 1.5-3 bp), charged at entry and exit on top of the bid-to-bid return (HistData bid-only); no swap (flat intraday). 2x run attached (3.0 bp per side, covering the brief's upper spread assumption).
decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos'): pass iff (1) one-sided t of the net-1x per-trade P&L (day-clustered; stationary/day-cluster bootstrap >= 430,000 draws; the lower) >= 3.6807; (2) net-2x mean > 0 (criterion 3); (3) criteria 4 and 7 of PARAMETERS.md (years, concentration, terciles of |m|, +-25% neighbours on the 0.70% threshold and on entry/exit minutes, one-bar delay) pass; (4) Red Team and re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read on histdata_cfd_1m_HKXHKD_holdout in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Anything else is 'refuted' or 'near-miss' (near-miss = t >= 2.0 with criterion 3 passed); the result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length. Sub-periods reported, not decisive: 2016-11..2019-06-14 (AHT to 01:00) and 2019-06-17.. (AHT to 03:00; vendor file still ends near 01:00), 2023 Stock Connect holiday trading.
notes: Source: candidates.md rank 30 (SC C-8-10, original transfer), prescreen-2026-11-06 #30 ('L: first batch-2 row after ingest'), Batch 1b list. EVIDENCE WINDOW: PolyU thesis and Cheng-Ng-Jiang on HSI futures about 1998-2005 (snippets only); Miwa 2019 Nikkei 2011-2017 (other market). HSI 2013-04 onward (after-hours trading launched 2013-04-08) untouched -> not derivative. Institutional change dates: 2013-04-08 AHT launch (IS start; no signal exists before it), 2016-11-14 AHT extended to 01:00 HKT (IS/OOS boundary, so the OOS signal window is homogeneous in the vendor file, which carries evening bars to about 01:00 HKT: QA halts 11:44 NY 2015-17 vs 12:59 NY 2018), 2019-06-17 AHT to 03:00 (sub-period). Closed families: H0012/H0017 (S&P overnight-gap fade, closed) share the reversal logic. Ruling as Pre-registration Officer: not a re-run - new market (HK), new data (HKXHKD), and a materially different signal (a traded after-hours futures print, not a cash-close-to-open gap, with entry after the futures open). D4 (19-CFD intraday rules, closed) did not contain HK50. Data (structure-only): HKX QA PASS; US anchor and mismatch-week releases place the clock (10 of 17 correct, 1 off, 6 undecided); the home anchor shifted 12 min on bad 2010-2018 winter prints, hence the Gate-2 precondition in rules; 144 gaps > 1 day incl. the common 2017-02-17..27 outage. OOS 8.1 years: bar 1.29 annual Sharpe; criterion-4 power 0.72/0.98/1.00 at true Sharpe 1.5/2.0/2.4; joint about 0.63/0.82/0.89 (8-year column). Economics: brief's 'one third of a 1% move reverts' gives about 30 bp gross, 21 bp after h 0.7, vs 3 bp round trip = 7x; that magnitude is an assumption, not a measurement. HONEST POWER: if a real effect is 5-10 bp per trigger against a ~50-60 bp s.d. of a 37-minute HK50 return on high-move days, per-trade Sharpe 0.1-0.15 over ~75 trades/yr gives annual ~0.9-1.3 and expected t ~2.5-3.7, power ~0.15-0.45; with P(edge exists) ~0.05-0.1 the expected passes are ~0.02. Red Team strongest objection: the CFD vendor's after-hours quotes may be stale/indicative (no AHT volume in HistData), and a 0.7% 'move' may be quote noise - answered only by the Gate-2 precondition and the cross-check against HKEX daily AHT summaries (Dept C, outcome-free). Firm clauses touched: FTMO intraday (trade inside 01:20-01:57 UTC, one FTMO day; 00:00 CE(S)T reset far away), 5% daily loss path-wise, funded +-2 min news rule (no order within 2 min of 09:30 HKT NBS PMI, 09:45 Caixin PMI or 10:00 NBS data: entry 09:20, exit 09:57). Futures firms: not applicable (HKEX not offered). Family hk-aht-reversal holds 1 of 5 counts after this row.
